title: done quality-gate configuration
description: Repository-side data for the done quality gate. Logic belongs in the skill; only commands and data belong here.

version.description: Accepted for backward compatibility and otherwise ignored.

repo.description: Repository name. Required: the Stop hook uses it to tell whether a signature belongs to this repository and refuses to run without it. Worktree directory names differ from the repository name, which is why this is not inferred.

verify.description: Commands run at completion time, in order. Optional and may be empty. Write only what no enforcing layer already guarantees: delegate to the repository's own check command where git hooks exist (lefthook run pre-push, pre-commit run --all-files), list only what CI cannot run where CI exists, and list the full suite only where neither exists. A flat list is canonical; the per-tier object form is accepted for existing configs, and the skill uses the list matching the chosen tier.

tier_floors.description: Minimum review depth. Never lowers a tier the skill judged higher.

full.description: Paths that force the full tier regardless of judgement.

full_conditions.description: Repository-specific promotion conditions a path glob cannot express, in prose the skill evaluates against the change (for example: authorization or security-sensitive changes, cross-package changes). Unconditional promotion triggers - the skill's own counter-examples never override them.

quick.description: Paths eligible for the quick tier, applied only when every changed file matches.

docs_checks.description: Documentation consistency statements to confirm before signing.

review_criteria.description: Review lenses for the standard and full tiers. The simplify lens is built into the skill and does not need listing here.

external_review.description: Provider for the full tier's independent review. Defaults to none; started only when named.

docs.description: Deprecated alias for docs_checks, kept so existing configs keep working. Use docs_checks; if both are present, docs_checks wins.

review.description: Deprecated alias for review_criteria and external_review, kept so existing configs keep working. Use the top-level fields; if both are present, the top-level fields win.

when_changed.description: Run only when a changed file matches. A single path may be written as a string.
